---
title: "Real-data experiments (RoLLR / S-RoLLR)"
output: html_document
---

Prostate (Section 5.1), Pima (Section 5.2) and HTRU2 (Section 5.3). Retinopathy is available in `DATASET_LOADERS` for internal use but is not in the manuscript.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
source(here::here("R", "00_setup.R"))     # or setwd() to project root, then source("R/00_setup.R")
```

```{r run}
datasets    <- c("Prostate", "Pima", "HTRU2")
n_reps      <- 300
train_ratio <- 0.7
base_seed   <- 2024

# Download HTRU2 once up front so the 300 resamples read it from disk.
cache_htru2()

cl <- makeCluster(max(1, detectCores() - 1)); registerDoParallel(cl)

cpp_exports <- c("d_tpsc_cpp", "tpsc_nll_cpp", "tpsc_transform_cpp",
                 "tpsc_rowloglik_cpp")

results <- foreach(ds = datasets, .combine = "rbind") %:%
  foreach(r = seq_len(n_reps), .combine = "rbind",
          .packages = c("Rcpp","glmnet","e1071","randomForest","lightgbm",
                        "mclust","pROC","MASS","Matrix"),
          .noexport = cpp_exports,
          .errorhandling = "remove") %dopar% {
    source(here::here("R", "00_setup.R"))          # workers recompile the core
    set.seed(base_seed + r)
    spec <- DATASET_LOADERS[[ds]]()
    idx  <- sample(nrow(spec$X), floor(train_ratio * nrow(spec$X)))
    sp   <- make_split(spec, idx)                  # train-only screen/impute
    out  <- run_all_models(sp$X_train, sp$y_train, sp$X_test, sp$y_test)
    cbind(dataset = ds, repetition = r, out)
  }

stopCluster(cl); registerDoSEQ()

if (is.null(results) || nrow(results) == 0)
  stop("All resamples failed - `results` is empty. Check the worker error above.")
cat("Completed resamples per dataset (of ", n_reps, " requested):\n", sep = "")
print(table(results$dataset) / length(unique(results$model)))

dir.create(here::here("results"), showWarnings = FALSE)
saveRDS(results, here::here("results", "real_data_results.rds"))
```

```{r summarise}
summary_tbl <- results %>%
  mutate(model = factor(model, levels = MODEL_ORDER)) %>%
  group_by(dataset, model) %>%
  summarise(across(c(auc, acc, f1, seconds),
                   list(mean = ~mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
                        sd   = ~sd(.x,   na.rm = TRUE)), .names = "{.col}_{.fn}"),
            .groups = "drop")
print(summary_tbl, n = Inf)

# Median wall-clock time per method per dataset
timing_tbl <- results %>%
  group_by(dataset, model) %>%
  summarise(median_seconds = median(seconds, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = dataset, values_from = median_seconds)
print(timing_tbl)
```
